text:
Leah: Rolling out the new HS->SF handoff fixes. Quick goals: validate webhook idempotency, round-robin fairness, and enrichment sampling. Plan: canary in eu-west, 1% -> 10% -> full, stop on duplicates.
Mark: For sampling let's do 25% enrichment to get more data. SLA targets: claim accept < 90s median, claim success rate >= 99.5%.
Priya: Middleware dedupe window = 60s. We rely on X-Redwood-Webhook-Id header for idempotency. Also ensure webhook retry backoff: 5s, 20s, 60s.
Carlos: Smoke test script: send 500 synthetic webhooks over 15m. Example curl: curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.test/hs -H "X-Redwood-Webhook-Id: uuid-1" -d '{"email":"ping+1@example.com","mql":true,"source":"blog"}' Then assert single owner claim and enrichment event with sampled flag if chosen.
ci-bot: Deploy rr-fix v2 to staging (eu-west) at 1739500120. Monitoring enabled: inbound.handoff.latency_ms, owner.claims.duplicates, enrichment.sampled_count.
Leah: Add a quick smoke checklist in the repo and attach to the deploy run. We should also export a CSV of sampled leads for QA.
Priya: Will add PagerDuty alert: owner.claims.duplicates > 0 triggers P1. Also add a slack alert to #marketing for any enrichment.failure > 0.
Mark: I'll watch SF owner audit and verify fallback mapping owner_email -> owner_id works.
Carlos: Running canary now. Posting results in ~20m with a short summary: total sent, sampled, dup_count, p50/p95 latency.
ci-bot: Canary started at 1739500150. Rolling to 10% at 1739500450 if no alerts.
Leah: Thanks team. If all green we'll proceed to full ramp after 1h observation.
